title: Velo Client 0.9.2
summary: The biggest Velo+ Addons update yet: a new Velo+ Addons category, 40+ modules for movement, combat, building and automation on your own worlds, a smoother Fly Boat and Cinematic Camera, and an Auto Eat that finally works.

blocks.text: 0.9.2 is all about the **Velo+ Addons** - built for your own singleplayer worlds and private servers: challenge videos, cinematic shots, minigames and practice.
Velo+ Addons get their own category

Open the mod menu (Right Shift) and every addon module now sits under **Velo+ Addons** at the bottom of the sidebar. Every module that moves, fights or builds for you only works in **singleplayer** or on servers you add to the **Private Servers** list in its settings - one list shared by all of them.
Add your private server's address under Private Servers once and every addon works there. Anywhere else they simply stay switched off.

items: **Fly**, **Speed**, **Jump Boost**, **Air Jump** and **Wall Jump** for flight and parkour scenes.
**Auto Jump** hops while you run (perfect with Speed) or only takes 1-block steps for you.
**Jesus** walks on water and lava, **Spider** climbs walls, **Safe Walk** keeps you on the edge of your bridge.
**No Slow** - no slowdown from eating, cobwebs or soul sand. **No Fall** and **Anti Knockback** keep you where you want to be.
**Arrow Dodge** sees incoming arrows and dashes out of the way.
**Inventory Move** - keep walking with a chest or your inventory open.
**Kill Aura** with hit interval, look speed and spread-hits for crowd scenes - it follows your reach.
**Auto Trigger** hits the moment your crosshair is on an enemy and your swing is charged.
**Bow Aimbot** for bows and crossbows, leading moving targets.
**Auto Crystal**, **Auto Anchor** and **Auto Totem** for fast-paced crystal fights.
**Auto Mace** lands every smash, and **Stun Slam** breaks a raised shield with your axe and goes straight back to the mace.
**Auto Pot** heals when you're low and re-pots Speed, Strength and more - from the hotbar or inventory.
**Auto Armor** puts on the best armor you carry, enchantments included. **Reach** and **Auto Clicker** round it off.
**Scaffold** bridges under you like a pro, **Fast Place** and **Fast Break** speed things up.
**Auto Craft** - lay out your recipes in a real 3x3 grid with item search, open a crafting table and it crafts them over and over.
**Auto Trade** buys the villager trades on your list until they run out.
**Auto Write** fills signs and books from your clipboard, wrapped to use every line and page.
**Block Finder** and **X-Ray** show the blocks you pick (all ores by default), each in its own colour.
**Entity Finder** now outlines the entity's exact shape through walls, with a colour per category and labels off by default.
**Fly Boat** flies smoothly now - the old burst / lag-back is gone.
**Cinematic Camera** no longer flickers chunks away when it grazes a wall, and has movement and look smoothing.
**Auto Eat** really eats now: it presses the hotbar key and holds use, just like you would.
Ender Chest Farmer, Auto Tunnel Miner and Auto Excavator now mine and place through the normal mouse input.
The launcher no longer reports a version mismatch for your Addons when a matching build is already installed.
